node.title: L1 m=4, h=3 tangent-radical exclusion
node.statement: For positive valuation, roots of the degree-p tangent polynomial T=2aR+3b lie on the degree-(nu+eta) polynomial X^nu H-kappa, while T'=2aX^(nu-1)V and deg V=p+eta-4. Comparing the radical and derivative multiplicity degrees forces nu+2eta>=4. This excludes (nu,eta)=(1,0),(1,1),(2,0),(3,0), so nu=3 is empty and only positive strata (1,2),(2,1) remain. At (2,1), rad(T) is the printed cubic and T/rad(T) is proportional to V. Nu=0 and the two positive strata remain open, so L1 is not closed.
